# UtilityBill.pk
> Free Pakistan utility bill calculators: electricity (all DISCOs and K-Electric), gas (SNGPL/SSGC), water, internet and phone taxes, net metering vs net billing, solar payback and bill splitting. Estimates only; not affiliated with NEPRA, OGRA or any utility company.

## Main tools
- [Utility bill calculator (all utilities)](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/)
- [Gas bill estimator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/gas)
- [Water bill estimator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/water)
- [Internet and phone tax calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/internet)
- [Split bills and monthly total](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/split)

## Electricity by company
- [FESCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/fesco)
- [GEPCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/gepco)
- [HESCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/hesco)
- [IESCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/iesco)
- [K-Electric bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/ke)
- [LESCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/lesco)
- [MEPCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/mepco)
- [PESCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/pesco)
- [QESCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/qesco)
- [SEPCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/sepco)
- [TESCO bill calculator](https://utilitybill.vercel.app/tesco)

## Notes
- Electricity base slab rates were last checked in November 2026 (unprotected: about Rs 22.44 to Rs 47.69 per unit before taxes).
- Gas, water and internet figures depend on the rates printed on the user's own bill.
- Net metering vs net billing buyback rates vary by source and change often; verify with the DISCO or NEPRA.
